issues.description: Default v3-beta speaker is 'shubh' but docs/PR claim 'aditya', causing silent voice mismatch
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS['bulbul:v3-beta'] sets default_speaker='shubh', but the module docstring, class docstring, and PR description all say the default is 'aditya'. Users relying on the documented default will get a different voice than expected. Pick one and align all three.

issues.description: Loudness lower bound silently tightened from 0.1 to 0.3, breaking existing configs
issues.detail: InputParams.loudness was Field(ge=0.1, le=3.0) and is now Field(ge=0.3, le=3.0). Any existing user passing loudness in [0.1, 0.3) will now hit a Pydantic ValidationError at construction. This is a breaking change with no migration note in the PR description and isn't strictly required by the v2 model.

issues.description: STT _connect no longer sends input_audio_codec, may break saarika streaming
issues.detail: The previous _connect built connect_kwargs with 'input_audio_codec': self._input_audio_codec for all models, but the new diff drops that key entirely. If the Sarvam SDK still requires input_audio_codec for speech_to_text_streaming (saarika:v2.5, saaras:v3), connections will fail or default to an unintended codec.

issues.description: Ignored-parameter warnings fire only on non-default values, missing explicit user opt-ins and comparing Optional[float]
issues.detail: Checks like 'elif params.pitch != 0.0' suppress warnings when a user explicitly sets pitch=0.0/loudness=1.0/temperature=0.6 on the wrong model, and the fields are Optional[float] so None != 0.0 also triggers warnings spuriously if defaults change. Use an explicit sentinel (e.g., field set in model_fields_set) instead of value comparison.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 speakers for unknown models
issues.detail: If a caller passes 'bulbul:v3' (mentioned as an alias elsewhere in the diff) or any future model name, the helper returns v2 speakers without warning. This will lead callers to validate against the wrong speaker list and ship invalid voice_ids. Prefer raising or returning an empty list with a warning.

issues.description: Drops 'bulbul:v3' alias previously accepted, breaking users who followed prior docstring
issues.detail: The old __init__ docstring listed 'bulbul:v3' as an accepted model and the old code routed it via 'model in ("bulbul:v3-beta", "bulbul:v3")'. The new strict validation only allows 'bulbul:v2' and 'bulbul:v3-beta', so any user who copy-pasted 'bulbul:v3' from the prior docs now gets ValueError. Add an alias or a clearer error.

review.summary: The PR cleanly refactors Sarvam STT/TTS around frozen ModelConfig tables and adds saaras:v3 and bulbul:v3-beta support, which is a good direction. However, the v3-beta default speaker disagrees with the docs/PR description (shubh vs aditya), the loudness lower bound was tightened from 0.1 to 0.3 (breaking change), and _connect no longer sends input_audio_codec which may break the SDK call. Secondary concerns are value-based 'ignored param' warnings that misfire on Optional fields and a silent fallback in get_speakers_for_model. The previously-accepted 'bulbul:v3' alias also disappears, which will break existing user code.
